3477.title: Codex lifecycle notifications become unhandled diagnostics
3477.rootCauseOneLine: Hook lifecycle coverage is unknown and generic warnings lack a validated handler, so both fall through to unhandled diagnostics.

prReviews.verdict: Closed and unmerged; static hook coverage fix only reviewed.

3477.proposedFix: Suppress routine hook statuses and normalize valid warning payloads; preserve unknown and unsuccessful diagnostics.
3477.caveats: Translator and assembler reproduction only; no live provider or browser verification.
